blocks.id_space: file stem (env_NNN), the identifier run_nextstep filters env_ids against
blocks.rule: within each stratum, the accepted members are shuffled with random.Random(block_seed) and split into equal consecutive slices, one per block, in the order given

seed_scheme: seed + generation_attempt (each draw is one integer step)
sha256_rule: sha256 over sorted (file name, sha256(file bytes)) pairs
